content.title: About
content.content: Fried rice without meat is a classic Chinese dish made from cooked rice, vegetables and soy sauce. The meat‑free version is suitable for vegetarians and anyone avoiding animal protein.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The dish is a staple in fast‑food stalls and family restaurants across China.
Traditional recipes include eggs, but vegetarian versions often replace them with tofu.
Rice used for frying is usually cooled beforehand so the grains stay separate.
Soy sauce gives the characteristic umami flavor and deep amber color.
A meat‑free version allows extra vegetables such as carrots, peas, corn and scallions.

items.title: Source of complex carbohydrates
items.content: Rice provides sustained energy and helps maintain stable blood sugar levels.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: B1, B3 and B6 support metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Contains dietary fiber
items.content: Vegetables add fiber, which aids digestion.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Absence of meat makes the dish lower in saturated fat, suitable for heart‑healthy diets.

items.title: Plant‑based protein source
items.content: Tofu or legumes added to the recipe boost protein content without animal products.

items.title: Soy sauce allergy
items.content: Some individuals may react to soy ingredients.

items.title: High glycemic index of rice
items.content: Portion control is advised for people with diabetes.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Soy sauce can increase salt intake; choose low‑sodium versions when possible.

items.title: Food safety concerns
items.content: Ensure the rice is heated thoroughly to prevent growth of Bacillus cereus.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the dish hot, often with extra soy sauce, chili or vinegar. Fresh herbs such as cilantro or scallions can be added for extra aroma.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2‑3 days. Reheat thoroughly until steaming hot to eliminate any possible bacteria.
